title: LATIN SWING VARIATION
style: latin electro swing 126 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, upright bass swing groove, conga percussion, brass section hits, vintage piano montuno riff, rhythmic chant vocal, call-and-response chorus, festival build and drop, warm club mix
lyrics:
[INTRO – conga rhythm + piano riff]

[HOOK]
Cha-cha Pelican
Move with the tide
Cha-cha Livewire
West side pride

[VERSE 1]
Swan River shimmer, Fremantle breeze
Deck full of mates, doing as we please
Pete on the wheel with the calm control
Brandon made steel turn into soul

Corporate cruise with the skyline glow
Raise that glass, let the rhythm flow
Rottnest sand in the morning light
Party on water, day into night

[PRE-CHORUS]
Hands to the sky
West coast high
From Perth to the reef
We don’t say goodbye

[DROP – LATIN PUNCH]
Cha-cha Pelican run
Under Western sun
Cha-cha Livewire roll
Heart and soul

Bounce with the beat
Move your feet
Indian Ocean heat

[VERSE 2]
Bucks crew laughing loud
No city lines, no crowd
Music your way, DJ spin
Private deck, let it begin

Carnac splash, Abrolhos wide
Montebello coral ride
From river calm to open blue
Every charter built for you

[BREAK – percussion only]
Uno, dos — feel the flow
Tres, cuatro — let it go

[FINAL DROP]
Cha-cha Pelican glide
West side ride
Cha-cha Livewire flame
Own the name

[OUTRO – brass fade]
